generation.scope: Unmarked regular Walsh rank-fourteen windows are classified by z on the affine line with the two points -1 and 1 removed. The opposite kernel pencils and their matched trace forms recover four intrinsic lines at every vertex, also at the ramification level. One shift sends z to -z; z=0 alone has period one and all other points have period two.

open_mathematics: Determine the irreducible parameter space and full-rank generic AS locus of tensors with a Walsh basis, its dimension after forgetting bases, and the incidence of the classified lower ranks. Continue AS coverage outside this symmetry class.
